summary: Accepted: the sealed one-operation candidate replaces only Yang Pu’s unsupported AD 921–922 installation interval with AD 921. Yang Wei’s death and Yang Pu’s sixth-month accession occur in the same eighteenth year; AD 922 has no source support. The candidate preserves the Chinese sequence wording and does not add, remove, or alter non-date content.

sourceChecks.group: Yang Pu installation after Yang Wei's death

evidence.quote: 十八年，渭死，溫聞之，自金陵馳歸揚州，夜入廣陵，議有所立。
由是群心乃定，遂迎丹陽王溥於潤州，以其年六月十八日即偽位，改元為順義。
初封丹陽王，渭卒，徐溫乃推溥為主，後僭偽號。

sourceChecks.reason: The chapter explicitly puts Yang Wei’s death in the eighteenth year and Yang Pu’s installation on the eighteenth day of that same year’s sixth month. In the already-audited chronology this is Tianyou 18 (AD 921); no cited source evidence supports extending this installation to AD 922. A point year AD 921 is therefore the supported Western normalization, while the source’s sequencing remains intact.
